issues.title: BiDi text corruption in code input
issues.description: Query syntax is fragmented and scrambled due to missing LTR text direction isolation within the RTL context.
issues.evidence: The focused query string displays broken syntax with tokens wrapped and reordered across lines.
issues.suggestion: Apply dir="ltr" and left alignment to the query code container.
issues.triageNote: Verified in screenshot: token spans are flex items in an RTL flex container, so token order reverses and neutral chars ( ) = / scramble; fix by isolating the query line with dir=ltr.

issues.title: Text wrapping in fixed-height input
issues.description: Multi-line query string wraps within a fixed-height field, resulting in cramped line spacing.
issues.evidence: Focused QueryInput shows two lines of text compressed within the same height as the single-line placeholder input.
issues.suggestion: Enable horizontal scrolling or auto-expand the input height when query text exceeds one line.
issues.triageNote: Height actually auto-expands (that part of the claim was a misread), but wrapping is not token-aware and inter-token spaces collapse because spans are blockified flex items (edge whitespace removed), jamming tokens together; switching the query line to inline flow gives real spaces and word-boundary wrapping.
